201.description: The tote with its contents, the new stock unit included.

schema.description: A reusable license-plated tote (ADR 0054) and its contents. Its logical location is the bin it is stowed in.

siteId.description: The site of the tote's bin. Absent until its first stow.

binId.description: The bin the tote is stowed in (its logical location). Absent until its first stow.

contents.description: One entry per stock unit in the tote, ordered by SKU then stock unit id; empty, never null.

items.description: One stock unit in a tote, in eaches.

ownerRef.description: Whose stock it is; omitted for fleet-owned stock (ADR 0045).

items.title: ToteContent

schema.title: Tote

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, ONLY when this response is a replay of the stored answer for the request's Idempotency-Key (the handler did not run again). The first execution of a key never carries it, and neither does a retry of a refusal that was not stored (ADR 0053: `concurrent-modification` and every refusal that depends on state that can change): that retry executes again.

400.description: Malformed body, an empty sku (empty-sku), a malformed ownerRef (invalid-owner-ref), or the Idempotency-Key header absent.

409.description: The tote is in no bin (tote-not-placed), the bin has no room (bin-full), the SKU fails the bin's placement rules (hazmat-zone-required, temperature-class-mismatch, hazmat-class-incompatible), the facility-layout lookup is unavailable for a Hazmat or TemperatureSensitive SKU (location-classification-unavailable), or a concurrent writer changed the bin or the tote (concurrent-modification). The same Idempotency-Key reused with a different method, path or body is also a 409 (idempotency-key-reused).
